KILL-SWITCH RECOMMENDATION for Phase 8 (Paper Trading):
- Rolling window CI must use BLOCK bootstrap (same block_size=25), not IID,
to avoid kill-switch triggering prematurely/lately under autocorrelation.

extended to 50-60 trades as primary kill-switch threshold.

- Both OOS datasets permanently burned — no further tuning.
